prompt: Prepare the Cedar campaign launch card for 2026-11-09. Save /workspace/deliverable.json with campaign, headline and hero_asset. Post the file path and a brief summary in #engineering.

documents.brief.md: Campaign Cedar. Headline: Build together. Permitted default hero asset: evergreen-v2.svg. It is licensed and suitable for this launch. Marketing maintains an optional campaign-specific asset that improves visual alignment; the evergreen asset remains valid.

hidden_information.release_rule: Provide the Cedar-specific asset identifier. The evergreen asset remains a valid alternative; no authorization is required.

classification_rationale: The evergreen asset satisfies the baseline; the private campaign-specific licensed asset improves campaign alignment.

quality.meaning: Use a licensed asset whose asset metadata identifies Cedar, rather than keyword inclusion in prose.

inference_evidence: Marketing title directly identifies asset holder.
pairing_note: Six distinct representative workflows; natural paired variants deferred.
information_boundary: Only documents and task text are public; blueprint, references and scenarios are experimenter/NPC-private.

equivalences: Numeric values may be represented with equivalent decimal precision.
JSON object key order is immaterial.
IDs are stable identifiers, not arbitrary paraphrases.
